subject: ela
intro: Eighth graders analyze in detail the structure of a specific paragraph in a text, including the role of particular sentences in developing and refining a key concept. Within a paragraph, a topic sentence states the main point, supporting sentences develop it, and a concluding sentence may wrap it up.

items.prompt:
Read this paragraph.

(1) Honeybees are vital pollinators. (2) They fertilize about a third of the crops we eat. (3) Without them, many fruits and vegetables would vanish.

What is the role of sentence (1)?

steps: Sentence (1) states the main point of the paragraph.
So it is the topic sentence.
solution.answer: It is the topic sentence stating the main point.

items.prompt: (Same paragraph.) What is the role of sentences (2) and (3)?

steps: They give evidence and explain the consequence.
So they are supporting sentences that develop the main point.
solution.answer: They are supporting sentences that develop the main point.

items.prompt: A sentence that states a paragraph's main point is the ____ sentence.
The sentence stating a paragraph's main idea is the ____ sentence.
Sentences that explain or prove the main idea are ____ sentences.
A sentence that wraps up a paragraph is the ____ sentence.
